items.title: Diamondback Energy Lifts Production Guidance, Reports Surging Profit on High Oil Prices
items.summary: Diamondback Energy  lifted its production outlook and reported a surging second-quarter profit, as it benefited from the run-up in oil prices following the start of the war in Iran.  The oil and natural gas company said it now plans to produce at least 522,000 barrels of oil a day.  It expects total production guidance to be at least 1,000,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, up from a prior forecast of 972,000.

items.title: Diamondback Energy’s (NASDAQ:FANG) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
items.summary: Oil and gas producer Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ:FANG) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 51.2% year on year to $5.56 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $6.48 per share was 8.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.
